title: Permission, liveness, and last confirmed action as distinct signer facts
warning: Field names are research vocabulary. The reporting-fix commit referenced by the source note is private; on-chain inactivity and live heartbeat output are the public evidence.

envelope.interpretation: Do not infer activity or recent settlement from permission alone. Silence without a heartbeat is ambiguous.

relatedAuthorityLesson: Bounded execution still needs inspectable signer health before an agent assumes an automated role will act.
